{{Citation}}
{{Quote|If this body is not capable of action, I suggest new leadership is needed. I move for a Vote of No Confidence in Chancellor Valorum's leadership.''"<br />"''(quiet conversation)...VOTE NOW! VOTE NOW! VOTE NOW!|[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] proposing a Vote of No Confidence|audio=VoteOfNoConfidence-TPM.flac|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:QueenAmidalaNoConfidence-TPM.png|thumb|right|300px|Queen Amidala calls for a Vote of No Confidence, an action that will put an end to Chancellor Finish Valorum's administration and unknowingly pave the way for the Galactic Empire, in 32 BBY.]]
A '''Vote of No Confidence''' was a decision to remove the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] from office due to a lack of approval in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="TPM" /> It was also used in the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The "Council of Blood"|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]].

[[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was voted out of office this way in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], resulting in an [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election for Chancellor]].<ref name="TPM" />

Under the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]], a Vote of No Confidence could recall the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]], as well as the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]].

The Vote of No Confidence could also be used by the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] of the [[New Jedi Order]], which invoked this right in [[44 ABY]] after growing greatly discontent with acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Kenth Hamner]]'s leadership and his desire to appease [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]. The Masters removed Master Hamner and elected Master [[Saba Sebatyne]] to take his place.<ref name="FotJ">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
